summary.text: Joe Vogel is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 17 who has served since January 11, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Vogel was born in Montevideo, Uruguay.
He earned a bachelor's degree in political science and government from George Washington University in 2018 and a master's degree in public policy from Harvard University in 2022.
His career experience includes founding the nonprofit Learn It Together, working as editor of the Harvard Kennedy School Review, and working as a campaign aide.
Vogel succeeded James Gilchrist in the House of Delegates, and for 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Ways and Means Committee.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Vogel named ending gun violence, defending reproductive rights and climate and environmental action among his campaign priorities.
